name: Hum Only
description: Turns the hum and hiss down 20 dB between notes rather than shutting them: the rests stay alive.

name: Natural Decay
description: Lets a held chord ring down before it closes, slowly, the way the string dies away.

name: Stutter
description: A high threshold and no hold: only the loudest attacks get through, chopped short.

name: Tight Metal
description: Shuts fast between palm-muted chugs: a short hold and release, so the rests between notes are silent.
